findings.title: BCMA is the most crowded target in the myeloma cell-therapy landscape.
findings.statement: 210 of 268 (78%) active clinical programs are BCMA-directed. Five products approved.

findings.title: 15% of recent field failures fall in the construct-level slice a binder-maturation platform acts on.
findings.statement: Of 34 programs terminated, withdrawn, or publicly deprioritized 2019 through 2025: 20 (59%) recorded strategic/corporate reasons as stated in registry/press language (not established commercial-pressure causation); 5 (15%) fall in the construct-level slice a binder-maturation platform acts on.

findings.title: The efficacy bar: cilta-cel 34.9 mo median PFS; approved TCE class 7.5-11.3 mo.
findings.statement: KM reconstructions across seven arms in four pivotal trials, all passing validation thresholds.

findings.title: The approved class is still generating labeled events six years in.
findings.statement: Teclistamab post-2025Q1: IgA nephropathy (n=36), IVth-nerve paralysis (n=31). 17,540 unique FAERS cases across seven products.

findings.title: Sequence-identity screen vs Celyad WO2020221873; identity vs the claimed CDRs tops out at 47%.
findings.statement: Max identity vs Celyad's CLAIMED CDRs is 47%. Six hits exceed 80% on the shorter-sequence metric (fewer on aligned length), all CDR2-vs-CDR2 and against an unclaimed comparator, in the one window whose numbering could not be reliably reproduced. No inventorship comparison is made here.

findings.title: Completed allotments through Nov 2022 (3 SH01); three later allotment authorities, none filed as completed.
findings.statement: Companies House: 3 SH01 completed allotments through Nov 2022; RES10 + RES11 authorities taken 2023-01, 2023-09, 2025-11 with no SH01 since. Resulting-capital figures are nominal, not valuations.

findings.title: The one public technical disclosure covers monomer VHH-CAR CDR3 maturation with a reporter-cell readout.
findings.statement: NeurIPS 2024 workshop preprint. No primary T-cell functional data. No multispecific geometry.

findings.title: The CB-101 multispecific program appears in exactly one venue searched.
findings.statement: One conference speaker-bio attribution. No corroboration across seven venues.

sources_list: Conference abstracts (ASH, ASCO, EHA, SITC, AACR)

specimen_note: Worked specimen of Varosync's diligence method. The subject company is anonymized; the comparator, trial, regulatory, IP, and financial evidence is unredacted at primary source. The method_audit below is verifiable in the evidence bundles you can fetch.

method_audit.what_this_surfaced: The engagement mapped the full competitive field (268 active programs across six targets), base-rated 34 comparable field failures against a taxonomy fixed in advance, screened the subject's patent position residue-by-residue against a predecessor's sequence listing, reconstructed comparator survival curves from published figures and validated them against the source, deduplicated a class-wide adverse-event corpus, and traced every pipeline and publication claim to its primary source. Several reads overturned assumptions in the engagement's own input brief. This is multi-domain, primary-source work a single-domain analyst or a one-shot AI pass does not assemble.
method_audit.scope_of_work: One diligence pass spanning clinical biostatistics (Kaplan-Meier reconstruction), pharmacovigilance (FAERS dedup and reconciliation), antibody and patent sequence analysis, and UK corporate-filing forensics, across nine primary sources assembled and cross-checked, compressing what would otherwise be multiple analyst-weeks.
method_audit.method_pre_registered: Methodology MYE-METH-v1.0 was hashed (sha256 short-hash ac1ede0299b7) and registered 2026-04-15, before the corpus was assembled on 2026-04-20. The 14-mode failure taxonomy was frozen before any event was classified.
method_audit.every_finding_traceable: Each of the 8 findings resolves to a fetchable evidence bundle keyed to primary-source identifiers: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT numbers, WIPO WO2020221873, protein SEQ IDs, Companies House filing codes, FAERS CASEIDs, and an arXiv e-print.
corrected_its_own_inputs: F-05: overturned the engagement's own premise. The flagged Celyad patent WO2020221873 is not a 'VHH-CAR' patent ('VHH' and 'single domain' appear zero times in its text); it claims a conventional VH/VL scFv.
F-03: trusted the trial PDFs over the input brief, correcting MajesTEC-1 risk-set timing and CARTITUDE-1's risk row (8 values, not the brief's 7).
F-06: removed an unsupported 'VP Investments' officer occupation that had no basis in the register.
F-08: held the single-venue CB-101 pipeline claim at LOW confidence after checking seven venue groups with zero corroboration, and marked it explicitly not load-bearing on any conclusion.
method_audit.reconstructions_validated: KM curve reconstructions (7 arms across 4 trials) were validated against published medians and landmark PFS points within about 1 percentage point (see efficacy.json independent_cross_check).
method_audit.bounded_where_uncertain: Limits are stated where they bite: FAERS counts are not rankable across products (no exposure denominator); efficacy is a cross-trial benchmark, not head-to-head; absence of a term in a paper is not proof the work was not done; the IP overlap concentrates in the least-reliably-numbered CDR window and weakens rather than strengthens the read.
